EmailTemplate.subject: Reminder: cocktails tomorrow at the Park Inn by Radisson
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Reminder: Cocktails tomorrow at the Park Inn by Radisson We're looking forward to seeing you! Get ready to unwind with us tomorrow night with drinks and hors d'oeuvres at Harald's Bar & Terrace at the Park Inn by Radisson. Just a quick 5-minute walk from the convention center!
The event details are as follows:
- Where: Harald's Bar & Terrace, 29 Heerengracht, Cape Town. (Go to the Park Inn by Radisson and head to the top floor) - When: Tuesday, April 4th | 5:30 PM - 8:00 PM - What: Drinks, food, and fun with your friends from Flywire!
In the meantime, stop by the Flywire booth to talk to the team about your payment challenges.
